title: LibriSpeech review demo
creators: Vassil Panayotov, Guoguo Chen, Daniel Povey and Sanjeev Khudanpur
description: A curated sequence of English audiobook excerpts, not a recorded conversation. Transcripts and speaker groupings come from the source dataset. Two turns are deliberately unconfirmed to demonstrate review. No model accuracy is implied.
modifications: Selected utterances concatenated with 250 ms silence; encoded to lossless FLAC.
